subject: science
passage: Saffron, one of the most expensive spices in the world, comes from the saffron crocus flower. Producing it is slow because almost every step is done by hand. Workers must complete three main ______ picking the flowers early in the morning, removing the thin red threads from each flower, and drying the threads with gentle heat.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Workers must complete three main tasks" is a complete independent clause, and what follows is a list that names those tasks. A colon placed after an independent clause is the right mark to introduce such a list.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon must be followed by an independent clause, but the list of tasks has no subject and main verb of its own.
explanation.B: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the list runs straight into "tasks," and the sentence can't be read clearly.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A period would leave the list "Picking the flowers … with gentle heat" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.D: Correct. A colon follows the independent clause and introduces the list of three tasks.
